appearance_facts.location: Title text at the top of the chart
appearance_facts.fact: The chart is titled 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4'. The word 'Stable' is part of the printed title.
A single blue line connects four data points, one for each quarter. The line has a positive slope, rising from left to right.
The line begins at the Q1 mark on the x-axis at a y-value of approximately 1,080.
The line rises to the Q2 mark at a y-value of approximately 1,330.
The line rises to the Q3 mark at a y-value of approximately 1,480.
The line rises to the Q4 mark at a y-value of approximately 1,840.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Revenue' and ranges from 0 to 2,000 with labeled ticks every 200 units.

printed_facts.fact: The horizontal axis is labeled 'Quarter' with tick marks labeled 'Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', and 'Q4'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Revenue' with numerical ticks: 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1,000, 1,200, 1,400, 1,600, 1,800, 2,000.
The full title reads 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4'.

public_definitions: Goal: Review the Company C revenue dashboard for the Q1-Q4 operations record, then choose the follow-up route for the revenue trend.
Options: Route to revenue growth response, Route to revenue stability response, Route to revenue decline response.
uncertain: The chart title explicitly uses the word 'Stable', but the plotted data shows a consistent upward trend (growth) from Q1 to Q4. It is unclear which visual element (title text vs. data trend) takes precedence for the routing decision.
